{{Otheruses|Ichor}}
'''Spirit ichor''' was the base for all [[Dathomir Magic|magic]] employed by the [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]] of [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. According to [[Mother (title)/Legends|Mother]] [[Talzin/Legends|Talzin]], it came from channeling the [[Daughter/Legends|Winged Goddess]] and manifested as green smoke.

==Usage==
[[File:SavageIsRemade-Monster.jpg|thumb|250px|Mother Talzin and her coven of dark crafters use spirit ichor to transform Savage Opress.]]
Spirit ichor could be manipulated in a large variety of ways by a [[Shaman/Legends|shaman]], primarily using it as a [[Force artifact/Legends|medium]] to access the [[The Force/Legends|Force]]. A powerful enough shaman could manipulate spirit ichor into physical objects, as demonstrated by [[Mother (title)/Legends|Mother]] [[Talzin/Legends|Talzin]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], who created a goblet of [[Blackroot/Legends|blackroot]] for [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] when he visited [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]]. Mother Talzin was also seen later to fashion a [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic]] lower half for her son, [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]], as well as conjure a [[Talzin's sword|sword]] wreathed in glowing green mist in order to combat [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]], her blade being able to easily counter Windu's own [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]. Spirit ichor could also be used for [[Heartshadow|divination]], [[mesmerism]], [[totem magic]], inducing [[Sleep/Legends|trancelike states]], temporarily [[Chant of Resurrection/Legends|reanimating]] the [[Death/Legends|dead]], producing the [[Water of Life/Legends|Water of Life]] for healing purposes, projecting [[Force lightning/Legends|lightning]] and [[Protection bubble|energy barriers]] and other uses.

As Mother Talzin did for [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]], [[Naa'leth/Legends|Naa'leth]], and [[Karis/Legends|Karis]], spirit ichor could be manipulated to produce a mist that allowed [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]] to operate "midway" between the physical and spirit realms, cloaking them with near-invisibility. [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]] was also transformed into an avatar of primal anger by Talzin and a coven of spellcasters via spirit ichor, granted him an enhanced physicality as well as an advanced [[Force-sensitive/Legends|connection]] with and ability to [[Force power/Legends|use]] the [[The Force/Legends|Force]] that allowed him to contend with experienced [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] such as [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] as well as [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] such as [[Dooku/Legends|Count Dooku]] and even [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] for a time.
